apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: Plex & Jellyfin client
apps.localizedDescription: Modern cross-platform Plex & Jellyfin client. This source is an unofficial mirror that tracks the IPA attached to each GitHub release automatically.

versions.localizedDescription:
## New features

- Shuffle a whole movie or TV library
- A Genres tab in movie and show libraries
- Continue Watching asks which copy to play when a title is in more than one library or server
- Zoom can be remembered per show, per library or everywhere
- Shader presets and Ambient lighting on iOS, Apple TV and macOS
- Match Refresh Rate on macOS
- A Linux AppImage, updatable with zsync

## Performance

- Desktop downloads run at full network speed
- Lower CPU use for E-AC-3 passthrough on Android MPV
- Lower CPU use on 32-bit Android devices
- Faster audio decoding on ARM devices
- Animated ASS subtitles use less CPU
- Memory no longer grows with every seek in videos with subtitles
- A video whose audio ends early no longer drains power on Android MPV
- Resizing the window reloads posters far less often
- Anime tracking downloads under 1 MB of ID data instead of ~8 MB

## Watch Together

- A guest who switches to another version of the file stays in sync
- The participant count on the Watch Together button can be clicked

## Playback

- Dolby Vision no longer plays green with Match Content Frame Rate on Android MPV
- A paused video no longer turns black after switching apps on Android MPV
- Subtitles stay in step with the picture on Android MPV
- Letterboxed Dolby Vision has black bars instead of gray on some Android TV boxes on Android MPV
- Unpausing with Passthrough no longer freezes the picture for a few frames on Android MPV
- Try transcoding is offered when a Plex server refuses Original quality
- Choosing between two same-language subtitle files no longer turns subtitles off on Jellyfin
- The screen lock unlocks by tapping its button twice instead of a long press
- A subtitle download that never appears says it may have failed
- The brightness swipe works on the inner display of iPhone Duo

## Profiles & startup

- Ask for profile on app open also asks when the app resumes over an open video
- A rejected Plex sign-in asks you to sign in again instead of going offline
- Resuming the app no longer marks a reachable server offline
- Plezy no longer crashes at launch on Android devices without Vulkan

## UI

- The Supporter purchase is now called the Theme & Icon Pack
- Continue Watching posters no longer switch between series and season after playback
- Watch trailer in Explore plays the trailer of the copy in your library
- Links that can't be opened show a message instead of doing nothing
- Light themes no longer show a gray band under the Discover and Explore toolbars
- The status bar no longer turns gray on Android 14 and older
- The Companion Remote stays on its tab after reconnecting
- Downloads are left out of iCloud Backup on iOS
- Tabs sit in the vertical bar on iPhone Duo
- Sheets and dialogs stay on one side of the fold on iPhone Duo
- The vertical bar hides during playback on iPhone Duo

## TV

- Focus highlights show in light themes
- Holding Select in lists runs the long-press action, such as picking a secondary subtitle
- OK on some IR remotes no longer opens the long-press menu
- The remote keeps working on a detail page after Apple TV wakes from sleep
- The library header no longer slides while moving along the top row on Apple TV
- Watch trailer on Apple TV opens the YouTube app
- Explore no longer offers links Apple TV can't open

## Desktop

- Plezy no longer opens to a blank white window on Windows
- 10-bit H.264 no longer plays gray on NVIDIA RTX 50 GPUs on Windows
- Leaving fullscreen during a refresh rate switch no longer leaves the display switched
- Window buttons stay in place after leaving fullscreen on macOS
